## Core Product

Klydis is a high-performance, self-contained LLM inference engine and chat application for Windows. Built on .NET 9 and LLamaSharp, it delivers:
- In-process AI inference with no external servers
- CUDA 12, AVX2, AVX-512 GPU acceleration
- Real-time hardware monitoring
- Dynamic memory optimization
- Modern dark-themed UI
- Support for all GGUF models (Llama-3, Mistral, Phi-3)

Download at https://klydis.co
